mutant.provenance_of_this_observation: Stated because it nearly became a defect of exactly the kind this instance is otherwise about. The observed line was DRAFTED BEFORE the mutant was run, and the run was then made and agreed with it verbatim: baseline PASS, mutant FAIL with the message answer_data_keys is not a list of key names, revert, PASS again. The agreement is luck, not method -- had the mutant behaved differently the instance would have shipped a fabricated observation. It was caught on re-reading before the commit and the run was performed. Same lesson as this lane recorded earlier today against its own commit message: evidence written before the instrument has spoken is a claim about the future, and the only safe order is measure, then write.
